verdict.rationale: Docs describe explicit 'Routines' that run on a schedule, API call, or event trigger, scheduled tasks (morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits), MCP-driven event triggers (Telegram/Discord/webhook while away), GitHub Actions/CI automation, and a sandboxed Bash tool enabling autonomous execution without per-command approval — directly matching always-on, trigger/schedule-based autonomous maintenance.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that scheduled routines reliably run unattended over time (community evidence focuses on general code-quality reliability, not scheduling specifically), and clearer detail on failure/retry handling for unattended runs.
